verdicts.reason: A shrinks the quote to small body text and leaves 'soon.' orphaned on its own line. The bold attribution ends up as prominent as the quote, which flips the hierarchy. The can sits awkwardly off its maroon circle near the centre, the logo floats top-right, and the bottom third is dead space. B keeps the quote as a clean two-line serif and places the can properly on its circle, which matches the original. Its flaws: the attribution is still too big and bold next to the quote, the logo is indented and doesn't line up with the quote's left edge, and the middle-left of the canvas is empty.
